reviews.title: Unauthorized Transaction
reviews.text: So I’ve subsribed to bilibili way before using my gcash account. I wanted to unlink or unsubscribe my bilibili account to gcash but it turned out that I wasn’t able to find a way to unlink it. So, I’ve come up with the solution to delete all my accounts in bilibili, including the one that was subscribed to my gcash account. It worked for a while and my money in gcash hasn’t been deducted for months. But, it came back. I don’t know how or why bilibili has been deducting money from my gcash even though I have already deleted my account. Please fix this.
